criteria.name: Visa acceptance
criteria.description: Approved as a SELT for UK Student visa

options.name: PTE Academic UKVI
options.summary: Computer-based approved SELT with fast results

options.name: IELTS for UKVI
options.summary: Approved SELT, more widely recognised per IDP, paper or computer

options.name: LanguageCert / non-SELT tests
options.summary: LanguageCert is an approved SELT; TOEFL iBT is not a SELT but many universities accept it

scores.rationale: Results often within 48 hours; 85.7% within 2 days in 2018 (Pearson), some delayed
Fewer organisations per IDP figure (interested source)
No source states IELTS UKVI turnaround
LanguageCert approved SELT; TOEFL depends on university

recommendation.headline: PTE Academic UKVI for speed, provided your university accepts it
recommendation.summary: PTE Academic UKVI is an approved SELT with the fastest verified turnaround; IELTS for UKVI is the safer pick if breadth of recognition matters more.

tradeoffs.text: IELTS reportedly recognised by more organisations, but source is IDP
Some PTE results are delayed by review

alternatives.when: You want maximum recognition or prefer paper

caveats: No source gives IELTS UKVI turnaround
Speed data is from 2018 and vendor pages
nextSteps: Book the UKVI version at an approved centre

contradictions.topic: Acceptance breadth: IDP says IELTS preferred; Pearson/IRO say PTE accepted for all visas
contradictions.assessment: Not strictly incompatible: both are approved SELTs; IDP figures are global, vendor-written and unverified. Treat IELTS advantage as plausible but unproven for UK master's.

uncertainties.text: 13,500 vs 3,000 acceptance figures come only from IDP, which co-owns IELTS
No IELTS UKVI results timing in sources
